channel.title: GetMyLocations Blog
channel.description: Guides on GPS, geolocation, IP lookup, and privacy-first location tools.

item.title: How to Turn On Location on a Laptop (Windows 10, 11 & Mac)
item.description: Turn on location on any laptop — Windows 10, Windows 11, or Mac. Enable Location Services, allow your browser, and fix the greyed-out toggle on a work laptop.

item.title: How to Turn On Location Services on iPhone & Android
item.description: Enable Location Services on iPhone and Android, fix per-app and per-site permissions, turn on Precise Location, and beat the battery-saver gotcha.

item.title: History of Latitude and Longitude — Sextants to Satellites
item.description: How a Greek scholar, a Yorkshire clockmaker, and a global voting conference in 1884 produced the two numbers your phone shows you today.

item.title: Why your maps app sometimes puts you on the wrong street
item.description: Five reasons the pin lands at the wrong door — interpolated house numbers, mislabelled buildings, and new streets the database has not caught up with.

item.title: What does my IP address really tell apps about me?
item.description: A plain-language look at what an IP lookup actually returns, what it does not, and why mobile data and VPNs make the city wrong so often.

item.title: GPS Coordinates in an Emergency — Send Your Location to 911
item.description: How to send GPS coordinates to a 911 or 112 dispatcher: what AML does automatically, the script to say on the call, and how to read them off any phone.

item.title: Browser Geolocation API — What Websites Can and Can't See
item.description: A walkthrough of navigator.geolocation: how it works, what the OS fuses into a coordinate, the permission model, and the privacy implications.

item.title: Share Your Location Safely — WhatsApp, Maps & Signal
item.description: Compare WhatsApp, iMessage, Google Maps and Signal for sharing your location. What each leaks, which duration to pick, and how to stop a share.

item.title: How to Find Your GPS Coordinates on Any Device (2026)
item.description: The fastest, most accurate ways to get your exact latitude and longitude — on iPhone, Android, Mac, Windows, and any browser. With privacy tips and free tools.

item.title: What Is IP Location, and How Accurate Is It Really?
item.description: Country accuracy 95–99%, city 50–75%, street level basically zero. The real numbers behind IP geolocation and why mobile and VPN break it.

item.title: Latitude vs Longitude — Which Is Which, and How to Remember
item.description: Which is which, the order in coordinates, signs, decimal precision, the three formats you will meet, and the antimeridian bug that breaks naive code.

item.title: How GPS Works: From Satellites to Your Phone
item.description: A clear, no-buzzword walkthrough of how satellites 20,000 km overhead let your phone know exactly where you are — and what can go wrong.

item.title: 10 Surprising Uses for GPS Coordinates in Everyday Life
item.description: From geocaching to verifying VPNs to precision farming — ten practical things you can do once you know how to read your own latitude and longitude.
